151.name: DENDELE
151.headline: Brazil's former Sharks lineup, fresh off a GC Masters title run
151.storyline: DENDELE (gafolo, koala, maxxkor, rdnzao, doc, coach coachi) are the former Sharks lineup and make their Major debut in Stage 1. HLTV ranks them #33 as of Nov 17. They opened Singapore prep with a 3-0 win over Imperial in the Gamers Club Masters VII final (early Nov, per HLTV results), after beating G2 2-1 at PGL Masters Bucharest. First match: PARIVISION on Nov 24.

152.name: BB Team
152.headline: BetBoom as BB Team: Stage 3 entry after a deep Bucharest run
152.storyline: BB Team is the BetBoom roster (Boombl4, zorte, S1ren, d1Ledez, Magnojez, coach Fierce), renamed for Singapore. As of Nov 2026 HLTV ranks them #7 and lists them as Europe's seed 6, starting directly in Stage 3 (Dec 2). Recent form: beat Spirit and NAVI at PGL Masters Bucharest before losing to FURIA, then finished 4th at IEM Beijing, beating FURIA but losing the third-place match to NAVI.

153.name: PVISION
153.headline: PARIVISION as PVISION: Stage 1 star power with Jame and FL1T
153.storyline: PVISION is PARIVISION (HObbit, FL1T, Jame, xiELO, zweih, coach dastan), renamed for Singapore. They start in Stage 1. HLTV ranks them #13 as of Nov 17. At IEM Beijing they beat G2 and Liquid before falling to NAVI on Nov 6, but lost 0-2 to HEROIC in a PGL Cluj-Napoca 2027 qualifier on Nov 16. They open Stage 1 against DENDELE on Nov 24.
